name: Clear Coat - int_wainscot
intent: One clear topcoat for int_wainscot. Repeats per ctx.clear_coats via scenario.dynamic_coats; SF interstage fires between coats.
doctrine: Clear for int_wainscot. Between-coat sand moved to MOD_INTERSTAGE_TRIM_STAIN_SF. Split from the previous combined sealer+clear module (mirror of the DSST split in 5fc5186) to support per-pass dynamic_coats.
